text:
Terrible service. My husband and sons pop was flat. We ask that we have fresh ones and our waitress said " well we tasted the pop it's fine so...fine" 

I had the seared tuna salad it tasted like a old bag of cole slaw with over cooked tuna. 

The boys had the chicken Caesar salad and the lettuce was wilted the chicken was burnt. 

The waitress didn't come back until we had to flag her down to pay the bill. 

We will never be back.
We love this place! I always ask of we can go to Browns over Earls, Joey and Cactus. Absolutely unreal restaurant :)
If my husband and I can sneak in a lunch date we usually end up at Browns. I'd love to say they have a great menu but honestly I'm so in love with their fish tacos I never order anything else!

Browns has a great menu. I know this from eating at a couple Browns already. So we thought we would try this one for brunch. I was torn between a steak for brunch or the Chilli Lime Fish Sandwich. I decided nothing beats a steak and Ceaser for brunch. Then they tell me they are out of steak. Wtf! Out of steak! But the fish sandwich was decent. It wasn't amazballs but it was good. The server was friendly, the bartender took forever. All in all it was a decent brunch but I prefer the Manning or Sherwood locations

I can't stop thinking about brunch! I love love a good brunch.

I haven't been here for after brunch food, yet. I will. Promise. But for the brunch it was a good selection and mad tasty. I ordered the avocado toast with poached eggs. The eggs were done to perfection. Served with a little baby salad that was so good. A perfect pair! (I mean, that is why they put it on the menu as such). It was a good size portion. Coupled with a mimosa and finished with an alkie coffee (I can't remember what it was called) made for a perfect, mellow brunch.

Our server was super nice and attentive. I cannot wait to go back!

The food and drinks along with service top of it's class

This is one of my favourite places to come on a Saterday night

Been here in the evening for drinks and appetizers and it was great. Brunch on Sunday is another matter!!! Slow service, waited 55 minutes for the smallest eggs ever. Waitress was slow. Limited menu for brunch too.

Came with a friend for a mom night out. Sat on the patio. Nice area lots of space outside and inside. Came around 8 pm. Normal selection of pub food and price same as everywhere else. My friend and liked it as we actually got to speak to each other without screaming over music. The waitress was great kept toping off our drinks. The location was great for both of us to get too. Plenty of parking. If you do plan to sit outside please put mostquito repellant on. I had plenty of bites when I left.

You lose two stars for a few reasons, I ate with my wife, and right behind me on the patio were a couple mouse traps....my wife hates mice, and I'm sure a lot of people do, maybe hide them a little better. Lose another star for the mediocre dinner menu, and I also watched an old lady use one of the cushions from the couch, to sit on because I imagine her hemroids were bothering her.  Breakfast was great tho, if I could give them 5 stars it would be for their breakfast alone.  Anyways they do have some good beers, and some great appys.  Little expensive tho, and oj's is better, plus no minors at oj's.

I really wanted to like Browns...I was so excited to have a spot in my neighborhood within walking distance from my house, but I've been there now about 10 different times in the past couple of years and it's just way too inconsistent. The service has been great, terrible, and everything in-between. I've had knowledgeable staff who could answer my questions about the menu, and staff who had no idea what was going on. The food is ok, but I have yet to find something on the menu that's my "go-to". The Nachos are good for sharing, and the wings are tasty. My husband really likes the Dragon Bowl, and the potato crusted cod is quite good too. I wouldn't suggest the fish tacos, I found that they tasted very fishy. As for their brunch, don't even get me started on the brunch...I had the eggs benedict and my husband got the waffles, both were incredibly underwhelming and not a great value considering the cost vs. quality of food you are being served. The waffle came out cold and rock hard, and the hollandaise sauce on my benedict tasted like mayonnaise. Fortunately for Browns, there isn't much competition in the area.

Browns, I'm trying to like you, but you're just making it so darn hard!

Met an old friend here before we went to a concert at the river Cree. Beer was good, but they could do with a better selection.  I had a potato crusted halibut bowl. Fish was good, coconut almond rice was excellent.  And the salad it came with was surprising and new. . Had beans and edamame peas in it. Other had fish tacos and pad Thai. . No complaints about the food.  It was busy, and with no acoustic consideration to the interior that made the atmosphere noisy and unpleasant. But that was the only issue

This new location just opened up in Lewis Estates by the Shopper's Drug Mart.  I was expecting it to be packed due to all the cars in the parking lot.  We walked in and I was surprised to see the "outside" eating area so nice.  There were about ten tables with a few customers seated there but also had a beautiful couch and pillows so customers waiting would be very comfortable.  The only thing about this "outside" area is that it's not really outside.  People must walk through this area to reach the inside of the restaurant to ask for a table.

We were lucky that there were a few empty tables so we got seated right away.  The menu offers a wide variety so there's something for everyone.  I love the burger and fries but this time I had the chicken tacos.  For $11.00 they gave me two large warm soft tacos with salsa.  I didn't go for the taco combo which would have come with black beans and rice.  My friend had the dragon rice bowl with chicken, she loved the coconut rice it came with.  We shared the brownie with ice cream for dessert and asked for it on two plates.  It was huge and very delicious.  I think this may be my new favourite restaurant!

Our server was great, refilled our water as she walked by even though the jug was on the table.  I will definitely be back to this location.
Great place. Super tasty fish and chip. The place gives off a great vibe. Nice place to eat, chill and have a cold beer.

It was my very first time just curious to try it out cause its litterally close to my house so rather than go find restaurants to eat along 100 ave for the evening i thought why not right at least eat have a couple of drinks then go home afterwards and rest. And bang on i was disappointed at all i came it wasnt much of a wait anyways then i finally sat down ordered my drink then i ordered my entree and wow i was so shocked that i didnt even have to wait that long usually 15 mins is the max but i got my food in under 10 mins which was impressive the server also gave good service asking me if i wanted another beer. Then when my entree was finished i wanted to try dessert and my server didn't disappoint me at all instead she recommended me to try that oreo something cheesecake she got me at chesscake right there so i order it and when i tried omg that thing is beyond good. I will be definately be coming back

Since this restaurant is close we go frequently!   Absolutely fantastic fish & chips - huge pieces of halibut, a wonderful fresh tasting coleslaw.  The chips here are the best I've had.  It's a huge amount of food and so good.  I've had the Hollywood Burger - huge and awesome and my favourite fries.  This is a two hander burger.  We've also had the French Dip - huge and delicious.  Their Thai Chicken Soup & Salad is great for lunch.  The soup is amazing and perfect.  We also went for Sunday Brunch for a birthday.  It's a limited menu but a delicious one.  Eggs Bene were excellent, as was the Corned Beef Hash.  It was a great breakfast for all.  I've noticed some reviewers complaining about portion sizes, which surprised me.  Everything we've ordered is huge.  I'm thinking the "healthier" choices are smaller in size, because they're healthier?  In any case, we've always had great service and food.  It's one of our go-to places.  Oh yes, they make a super Caesar, perfectly mixed.

I've visited Browns Socialhouse a few times. The food is okay, a little over priced for what you get and overall taste is okay.

Anyways yesterday I went with a couple friends and was VERY disappointed with our service and our food. To begin with our server had a bit of an attitude to begin with. She seemed bothered by having to serve us and overall had a bad attitude. She never once came to ask us how we were enjoying our food. Anyways I had ordered a full order of nachos to share with my boyfriend. I was thinking a full order should be pretty big and we should be able to split it no problem. It was the saddest full order of nachos I have ever ordered. I had to ask the server if the plate that she had given me was really a full order.. It was. The plate was not that big and there was minimal cheese on the nachos. Big fail on the nachos. Won't be ordering that ever again.

Our friends just wanted to order dessert and ended up ordering the Oreo Cheescake Jar (I can't quite remember the name) It looked delicious and our friend said that it was great! Our other friend had ordered a key lime pie and was very disappointed when he received a tiny (I'm not exaggerating) slice of pie. He finished it in about 3 bites. He said it was good but way too small for $7. 

Overall our experience was meh. For what you're paying you might as well go somewhere else. The portions are too small, the food is ok. I don't think I'll be returning anytime soon.
Came for a late dinner  (11:30) the staff looked really tired but they managed to pull through and still provided us (7 people) great service and delicious food. And the price was pretty reasonable

We came here on a week night at 7 and were surprised to find the place packed and about a ten minute wait for a table. This place was very dark and very much like the windermere location but felt smaller somehow. Again I had a hard time finding something on the menu that appealed to me. They had a feature menu which I ordered spaghetti and meatballs. Again like the other location the food wasn't bad but just mediocre. Nothing to rave about or worth driving to the west end for. Our server was polite, more so than the other location. I guess I just don't see what all the fuss is about and assume it's only busy due to the location for those living on the other side of the henday.
The food sucks here and service is very slow.They are corn crazy seams like they put it in everything.Why would anyone ever put corn in won ton soup.So nasty couldnt eat it.Also very loud

Poorly organized restaurant. Have been twice and both times half the tables were empty but had to wait over an hour for our food and 20 minutes to get drinks.  The food was decent when we received it but I won't be returning due to lack lustre service and poor overall organization

I like it here.

The first time I was here I had serious sticker shock over the prices, they are definitely more than what you'd pay at a comparable fine casual type chain (Moxie's, Milestone's, etc) and I was seriously put off. With that being said, the food is really really good and if you order what's on special you are definitely getting your money's worth.

The space definitely isn't very large inside so sometimes you have to wait a while for a table but that's par for the course in Edmonton (nobody cooks at home anymore! Everyone eats out all of the time!). Good aesthetic and fantastic bathrooms, I love them. 

Service has been great every time I've been, the servers are really pleasant and chatty and knowledgeable. I really like their sangria (pink is my favourite!) and social soda to drink and for food, you can't beat any of the flat breads.

I'm really pleased to see more establishments going in on my end of town... I don't mind driving, but it's nice not to have to. If you want something different from OJ's be sure to come here. Plus if you have children I'm pretty sure that they allow minors, so that's a plus for you.

Disappointing.

We took my mother out for Mother's Day and even though not all the tables were filled, the service was very slow.
I did notice A LOT of food being prepared for take out or delivery so that may be the reason for the slow service.

The food was not consistent at all. My mother and I both ordered the same spicy, crunchy chicken sandwich. While hers was a fair sized portion, mine was almost half the size of the bun.
My fries looked like they dumped in the burnt ends at first, then just put some fresh ones on top.

My sister ordered Ahi Tuna Poke - it was a nice dish, but certainly not worth $19.

I did tip our waitress fully as the food is out of her control as is the decision to put Skip the Dishes as a priority over eat in customers.

I also explained my concerns to the manager on duty.

We will not be back.

This place would have received five stars, but unfortunately even though it was pretty quiet when we were there, the service was very slow. The first waitress we had seemed entirely uninterested in serving us. A second waitress came after about 20 minutes to take our food order and she was much friendlier which was a bonus. We waited another 20-25 minutes for our food to come which we normally wouldn't mind; however, I am unable to sit for long periods of time due to hip surgery, so we did get a little antsy. Once the food arrived, it was absolutely delicious. My husband ordered the poutine burger on the feature menu and I ordered the halibut street tacos. We couldn't say enough about the quality of food. The tacos were HUGE and bursting with flavour, and the home cut double cooked fries that came with the poutine burger were something else!

Finally, something different for Northeast Edmonton!  Healthy choices abound as do the old pub food favorites like burgers and fish and chips.  My husband and I had the potato crusted halibut bowl with the coconut almond rice and salad, and it was absolutely delicious!  Today, we had brunch with the poached eggs and hollandaise on corned beef hash, and it was very good, as well.  We've found the staff to be well trained and attentive.  Yes, it's a sports bar, and there is more noise than a fine dining establishment, but it's not reasonable to downgrade it for what it is.   Without any major sports games on, the restaurant was full at 2:00 p.m. on Sunday, so Brown's is doing quite well!

Our first visit with a party of four. Very slow service and dirty glasses of water to begin our lunch. Our orders were simple..  2 salads, one chicken sandwich and one pizza. We waited approximately 30 minutes for our food. Once it arrived the portions were very small for the price of the item ( $16.95 for the salad) 
The salads had very few mixed greens and mostly contained the prepackaged iceberg lettuce and grated carrot. The taste reflected the poor quality. The chicken sandwich and fries were so over salted they were not finished. However my friend did enjoy her pizza. We even spoke to the manager offering our suggestions to the newly opened restaurant. We quickly stated our concerns and we were quickly dismissed as well. We stated we did intend to pay for our lunch but only wanted to comment on the service and the quality of the food. How disappointing we went unheard. Atmosphere, service, food quality and price this restaurant fails on every level. Do not waste your money..... Or your time.
THIS IS THE NEW BROWNS SOCIAL HOUSE IN SPRUCE GROVE!

Patio is great minus the fact they allow minors on it !!! 
They have a sign hung that says beer garden yet I don't know many beer gardens that have kids running around in them. If I'm going to pay north of $16 for a burger I'm going to go somewhere that separates their dining room and lounge from minors

I ordered their nachos. They asked me if I wanted any chicken in it. I don't eat meat, so for sure no thanks. Got the nachos, ate it. There's chicken in it.  It was nice they got me another one for half price though. Very generous. Would not go back.

I've been here a couple of times now and it has been a very welcoming place. I have been to the other Browns in Windermere, in Grande Prairie, and even in Yorkton. It is always pleasant to go there to see the friendly staff and enjoy a pint of a Granville beer. 

For their food they have a great menu - their Dynamite Rolls are, well, dynamite! 

The main thing I have come here for is a beer after work with a friend. Since this location is along Henday it is quite convenient when I live in the south west and some friends live in the north west - nice middle point. The beers are always cold, the atmosphere is always friendly, and we can relax after the day and chat. 

Cheers!

My friend and I were running some errands today and happened to be on the west end so I suggested coming here for lunch - the reviews keep popping up on my Yelp feed and I've been curious to try it (why are all the locations on the outskirts of the city?).

I really like the atmosphere - the beer garden is inviting, the interior is well decorated and sophisticated without being too fancy, and there are some tv's to keep score when sports are on, but they don't overwhelm the space.

The menu was amazing - there were almost too many things to choose from. I really enjoyed the $5 social Lager - the beer was crisp and refreshing. My chicken sandwich was good, though spicier than anticipated (mostly because it wasn't indicated as being spicy at all...), though a giant mess. The fries were perfect, slightly crispy on the edges but kind of soft on the inside. My friend ordered the roast beef sandwich and it was perfect - honestly one of the best I've ever tried. They put the horseradish aioli ON the sandwich instead of as an extra dip - genius.

What really turned me off was the service. Our server was friendly enough... when we saw him. I noticed our food come up on the counter a solid 5 minutes before it was ever brought to us (eventually by the bartender). The only napkins were the ones the cutlery was on - and given that we both had messy sandwiches I really could have used some more. I eventually had to steal some from the next table since our server never returned. They give you ketchup in portioned containers, which is fine, but I ran out and had to wait for a few minutes until I could ask for more (even though I foresaw the shortage at the beginning of the meal and would have asked immediately if anybody had come by to check on us). It was another 5 minute wait to pay when the bill arrived. 

Overall, while this might be somewhere I'd frequent if I lived in the area, between the crappy service and the steeper prices this isn't somewhere I'm going to go out of the way for.

Had a really good experience at this Browns when my family went out for mother's day. The restaurant is very nice on the inside, it's similar to an Earls, Moxie's, Central etc. There's a lot of seating as well - everything from large tables that can seat a whole group of people to single seating at the bar. There were four of us and we were seated right away - it wasn't busy at all which meant the noise level was pretty good. Our waiter was attentative and nice, regardless of our mains taking a little long to arrive. We started with the calamari and chicken bites - both were great! I wouldn't say that there was anything spectacular or special about the calamari, it was exactly what you would expect. The chicken was very tasty and had a delicious sauce/chip topping but it was a little bit on the dry side. For me this wasn't a big deal because I'm whiter than white and can still enjoy a dry chicken, and frankly the crust and topping was so good it didn't really matter that much to me. Like I said our mains took a little longer than it should have to come out, but I enjoyed mine regardless! I ordered the chicken sandwhich with yam fries. Of course, the yam fries were super addictive, they were salty and cooked well. The chicken sandwich had a great flavor... But if you're looking for a big juicy piece of chicken you would be disappointed. The chicken was quite thin, about a fourth of an inch in width and again it was on the dry side. The flavor I think made up for it and honestly I was okay with my belt staying intact for once, considering it wasn't too too filling. I had the whole meal and felt full but not dead which is great for someone like myself who has no sense of control when Saturday hits. The bun I have to say as well was really good - I believe they use a 'potato bun' (don't come for me if I'm wrong, I might be making stuff up) because the bread was really soft and chewy which made the sandwhich way better. Overall I would probably come back here with a group of friends - it seems like a good place to bring a lot of people. There's a lot to choose from on the menu, lots of seating and TV's and a large selection of drinks. Its a perfect 'group resturaunt' in my opinion.
It is a nice neighbourhood restaurant. Awesome specials on sunday and monday evenings. Pizzas were ok. We liked the patio. Inside looked too dark for our tastes.

I came with a group of girlfriends to celebrate a birthday.  It was great when I called a few days before to find out they take reservations which seems to be rare at most restaurants for a Friday night.  I made a reservation for 5:30 and was told they don't get busy until 6ish.  We arrived a little after 5:30 and found most of the tables were occupied so I'm glad we made a reservation.

The seating was comfortable as it was a half booth, and half chairs and I sat on a chair facing the window and there was a TV above me with the hockey game on.  They opened the blinds while we were there so that lightened the place up a little.  

Our server came to take our drink orders and my friend asked about a happy hour they have for $4 for the Social Soda which she saw on their website.  The server did that d'uh uh, no we don't have that, even though I checked it on the website and it's says Monday-Friday from 3-6PM.  Always great with the staff don't know the specials and give you a look that they think you're making it up.

After ordering our meals, we had a chance to catch up.  It gets noisy in here but not as bad as shout in each others' ears noisy.  It didn't seem to take long before the food arrived at our table.  I ordered the blackened fish burger for $18 and it came with fries as all their burgers do (you can change to a salad, yam fries, or poutine for extra).  The halibut was seasoned well and was a great combo with the coleslaw.  My friends also seemed to enjoy their burgers, fish and chips, steak sandwich, and rice bowl.  

I'm not a big fan of BSH but I would come back if it was to celebrate an occasion.

Went here a few times already and it's just getting worse and worse, I was giving it a chance because maybe they'll do better next time but no. I come here because it's near my house and it's an easy place to hangout and have a drink. The last time I was here was the last draw. I ordered calamari to start (I always order calamari, first because it's a safe bet and second I love calamari), I was so disappointed. It was dry, bland, and you can't even see or taste the calamari. It's just one whole blob of over cooked breading and oil. Also I ordered ice tea to start with and literally taste like nothing. I should've just ordered water and not get charge. I just wanted to get out there and go to a waaaaay better place than this one. I told my boyfriend it was just not worth it because every time we go there it's just disappointing. It was just not worth telling them anymore as I don't see any improvements.

Being so close to home, this is one of our frequent haunts. The service and food are consistent and good. I do like that it's a "nicer" menu than a typical bar and has a variety of items to choose from. I can have wings and dry ribs, or I can have a poke bowl...it's a nice range of choices. 

I do have some favourites: try the gravy. I don't eat a lot of fries typically, but I will for this gravy. It's as though they took the gravy from NY Fries and KFC and mixed them together for this unique, addictive taste. Trust me. Also, the oreo cheesecake jar. It's super light and fluffy mousse-like deliciousness with cookie crumbs and a whole oreo to top it. So freaking good. I won't lie - I've gone for dinner and ordered just fries/gravy and dessert. Don't judge. 

Cheap house beers and wine ($5) and it's a good night. I also love their covered patio with huge heaters overhead so you can sit "outside" basically year round.

Great little neighborhood restaurant! The atmosphere is inviting, they have a patio with fireplaces, booths and high tables with stools. The staff is very attentive, they greet you as soon as you walk in the door. The food was great! I had the Beef Dip and my hubby had a Steak. Both were very tasty. Prices were good, right on par for this kind of restaurant. We will certainly be going back.

Browns is a bit of a lunch time favourite for the people around my office (we're way out in the west), so I decided to check it out. 

The venue has a nice patio area - noted for the summer! It has a cool fire pit in the centre (gas powered). The restaurant area features your usual pub mix of booths, low and high tables. Decor is kind of a mix of brick work and leather - lush. 

In terms of menu it's sort of along the lines of the "other" gastropubs in town. Pizzas, salads, sandwiches, some Asian dishes. I went with a beef dip au jus, tasty! The beef was nicely done, not over cooked.
My favorite Brown's location. Great food, great service and a great venue. Haven't had the pleasure of the outdoor dining but inside was nice and clean.

My friend and I come here on a fairly regular basis and share an appie and some wine. The appie's were never anything to write about, the wine selections nice and the service was always friendly so I had nothing to critique or celebrate here so they would have gotten a mediocre three star review.

Until... We actually went this week and had a meal. Holy crap, I love this place! This is going to sound crazy but this is about the best roast beef french dip I have ever had! My friend had the dynamite sushi rolls with cowboy salad and loved it too. I am so sad I could only finish half my meal and left my leftovers BEHIND! This is something I do on a regular basis (forget to take my leftovers), but in this case I was really disappointed! 

The service is always great and servers are super friendly, great staff! 

I deducted a star because I saw something really strange while I was at this "Socialhouse"... Minors!? I really don't want to hear that while I am at the bar/ pub/ socialhouse, and it ruined my experience a little.

Great atmosphere, I feel it has a limited menu, not as noisey as Canadian brewhouse(sports bar) brown decor mix of high tables and low tables padded seats with bar area in middle, with glass covered patio separate from main area.

overrated place. OMG, miniature food. the plate was half full only. i ordered the salad with chicken, my friend ordered a sandwich and we both left hungry. the quantity is so small and this place is definitely not worth the money. the seating is average and the food tastes just average. will not go back

We sat on the patio, music was a good volume, we could talk just fine. Waitress was great  We ordered the calamari for a starter after seeing it mentioned in a few reviews. Unfortunately it was a sad disappointment. Ours was very very bland. The fish tacos were good. Big battered fish portions in each, good of that's what you like, thank goodness we shared! Upgraded to yam fries, they were very good, perfectly cooked and large portion! Breeze on the patio was sooo nice!
Great food, a bit slower because it was busy but, we still had a wonderful time ! The blackened fettuccine and the dragon bowl are some of our favourites.

Good service, great environment, and the best lemonade I've ever had. My boyfriend hardly likes restaurants because he always says "I can make this better at home", but he loved the crispy chicken sandwich. I got the tuna poke bowl, since that's what I get at earls and cactus club, but it wasn't what I was wanting so it wasn't great.
Small portions on an oversized price.  I'm not sure how it is getting as many stars as it has.  Avoid the horseradish in the Caesar, as it isn't done well.  This is one place to skip!

Thankfully much better than my experience at another Brown's... but still not blown away.  The prices are much too high for what you get here.

The food was good though... everyone at my table was quite satisfied with their choice.  I went with the Cajun Chicken Ceasar Salad.  The chicken and bacon were really delicious... but the salad dressing was really bland.  I was focusing mostly on the meat in this "salad".

The service was great though - she kept all the beverages full throughout the meal, which was nice.

My biggest issue is that we went for lunch on a Friday and beginning to end we were there for a little over an hour.  That's really not acceptable during the week!

Also... they don't provide a dessert for your birthday :(
Good- food, great service ,we had to wait for a table because we missed the text they sent when one was ready .
My friend and I went, the food was amazing. The service was very friendly and prompt. Over all we will be going back!

I've been here once before in Kelowna and it was fine so my wife and I decided to go to the location in Edmonton. I ordered a chicken sandwich with fries and gravy. I ordered my sandwich with lettuce and tomato only. It ended up coming with cheese so I sent it back. 

It returned not more than a minute later still sizzling from the fryer. I took a bite and I was thrown off immediately, something was not right with this burger. After taking a closer inspection I realized they peeled the cheese off the previous burger and re-fried it hoping I wouldn't notice. 

The fries were also undercooked and the gravy was disgusting. My wife also did not enjoy her dragon chicken bowl. Overall terrible experience. We won't be back.

Great place to go on a Friday night.  Been there 3 times now and have not have a bad experience, service was great and quite fast, food is on par with what you'd expect in that price range.  They best patio I've ever seen, every smart design.  I'd recommend it to any of my friends.

We have been here twice and both times were decent. The margarita pizza is great, but very inconsistent. One time there was only 1 basil per slice the next time. However the dynamite roll is always amazing! I am a fish taco snob. And I wasn't a huge fan. But it was still good. The beef dip though was very good. Get the havariti and extra mushrooms! The social red is really good! Give it a try. The service was good. However I do not like being put at a long table beside other people. All in all it is a good place and prices arent bad during happy hour

We decided to try a new restaurant tonight, and I am super glad we did. The service is fast and extremely friendly. We ordered nachos and they were amazing, super authentic and high quality ingredients. We tried a few new drinks that were recommended by our server and they were great!!! The atmosphere is cozy, and perfect for a date night. We will be back, and I give this place 5 stars.

Mediocre food. Crap service. I wouldn't come back. The dessert we ordered sucked. The waiters didn't even acknowledge when our glasses were empty and we definitely wanted refills. I don't suggest this place. It should close down! Also might add the weird set up. Not appealing at all.

I am pretty excited to try out this great addition to the North side of Edmonton! This is area just keeps on growing and has a lot to offer. Quick and easy to get too just take the exit off the Henday to the Manning located in Manning Crossing ! 

The service is excellent all are very friendly , food is great. A little on the pricey side but worth it. 

Kids are welcome!

I've been coming to Brown's longer than 2 years. Started coming to this location when I moved last year. The menu is great. Lots to choose from. My fave dish is their blackened fettuccine carbonara it is so good. I love it. Their spicy crispy chicken sandwich is so tasty. They got good fries too.  Nice atmosphere and good people. The waitresses are very nice very friendly. I'll keep coming back

We stopped by for a bite of lunch. This was actually my first time going to Browns Socialhouse. The restaurant was surprisingly kid friendly as from the outside I always assumed it was more a pub type establishment. The menu was on the slightly pricier side with food comparable to other restaurants of the same caliber. I tried their wicked Thai soup with ceasar salad and garlic bread. Everything was tasty and cooked to perfection. The restaurant was very modernly decorated and offers a great ambience for chatting/catching up with a friend. The service was friendly and helpful. I would definitely recommend this location to others and you might find me here or at another Browns Socialhouse location in the very near future!

LOVE this location...I feel like I am downtown having lunch rather than in the middle of a new development of residentialville! 

This restaurant has style, great food and it has unique appeal for the works for the masses. We had a work lunch here with 10+ and the staff had no problem accommodating our meals with special requests all while on a quick turn around. 

The meals all had an interesting spin to their serving style or introduced a small change to a typical recipe. I had the Caesar salad which was served separated and an avocado...sounds bizarre but it worked well and felt really upscale at a good price. 

My friends all seemed to enjoy their meals as well with the minor exception of a pasta dish. The ladies who ordered it had gotten a whole order and a half order but it was super hard to tell the difference in anything but the price . The meal still included a full chicken breast and a slice of bread with just a slight amount more of pasta...likely happens more often than we notice.
I have been there last night for the first time and the food was amazing loved the fish tacos that my husband order and also the dragon bowl with teriyaki chicken was awesome. Will be back very soon

Our experience could not have been any worse. We were going have a family brunch and had made reservations for 14 people.
 One hour after placing our order the manager approached our table and stated that the order would be out shortly and they wanted to ensure that every thing would be fresh. Although the wait was long we took it in stride and within 10 minutes our orders arrived.
Sadly the food was anything but fresh. Two of us had eggs Benedict and another had the poached eggs and avocado. These were by far the worst eggs Benedict we had ever tried. they yolks on all orders were rock hard, cold, and topped with Hollandaise sauce that had the consistency and taste of packaged powdered hollandaise. Not only that but, but the sauce had come directly out of the fridge and was frigid. This on top of cold eggs. Yuck. Also one of my eggs was only egg white, I guess the yolk must have been left in the poaching water. 
I sent the order back and five minutes later the manager came to the table to find out what the issue was. We told him and he offered to replace the orders but it would be twenty minutes. By this time over an hour had passed and I was not prepared to wait another twenty minutes or more.  Another guest also had eggs and again they were inedible, he mentioned it to the waitress but was told that there was nothing they could do as they were very busy. 
This was just the tip of the iceberg, French fries that were all clumped together, I didn't even know that such a thing was possible, fried potatoes that were rock hard and totally lacking in flavour, the waffles, they were topped with blueberries that were ice cold, really, ice cold berries on top of hot waffles. Where do they find these "Chefs"?
Needless to say, due to the total incompetence on the part of the manager and kitchen staff our Sunday family get together was spoiled. We won't be visiting any browns social house in the future, once was enough. 
Oh, and by the way, the restaurant was only half full, I dread to think of what things would be like if they were truly busy.

While I enjoyed my visit here, I wasn't blown away. The food was great- and I really mean that, but I was not thrilled with the service or drinks. I went with my mom on a weekday around 12PM and there was no wait for a table which was nice. The atmosphere inside is quite lovely and updated with a range of higher tables and lower tables for both small and large parties. I thought, okay, this is going to be really nice. I was correct in some ways but wrong in others. 

We ordered drinks, mine being a G&T and my mother getting a wine. They were pricey but not bad. Her wine was fine, but my gin and tonic tasted (I'm not even joking) like pool water. Gin and tonics are the only thing I drink and I've had a lot of them, some being better than others. But this one was absolutely horrendous. I notified the waitress after trying to flag her down for about 10 minutes and she said that they're in the middle of fixing the soda thing. Well, okay, would have been nice to know before I ordered it. She took it away and replaced it and it was fine the second time around. Just kind of unusual. She wasn't overly apologetic about it either, but rather just kind of shrugged it off which was a bummer. 

Anyways, we ordered a poutine and a margherita pizza to share. Both were great but it was overpriced for the quality of the food we received. I feel like we could have gone to a cheaper restaurant and gotten essentially the same thing. I'd like to go back and try other things on the menu, but being a broke student I probably won't be jumping hurdles to return.

I have come here several times now. 

As always I order a Browns Social Drink, either the lager or the 'soda'. They are both enjoyable and affordable. 

Off the food menu I've tried a couple different items and never been disappointed. 

My all time favourite is definitely the French Dip. The bread is crusty and perfect for soaking up the Jus. The meat is flavourful and tender. This sandwich overall is just fantastic. 

Both the fish and chicken taco has never let me down. Perfect flavour combinations. Comes with two tacos so my partner and I tend to get both and split it. 

When I'm craving a classical fish and chips I think of Browns first. Good quality fish in a delicious batter. 

This is my 'go-to' place when I'm looking for a nice meal.

Went here for happy hour with some friends. It was beautiful inside. Love all the fire places. There is also a lovely patio area that must be wonderful in the summer. Our server was courteous, professional and prompt.  Really good menu. Lots of variety that people that are polar opposites when ordering (ie my husband and I) can find something to eat and both be happy. I had a social hour soda which was delicious and refreshing and a good bang for your buck. I also had the happy hour southwest salad (no chicken or cheese included in this one) and I had an ahi tuna taco. I wasn't expecting much from a chain restaurant, but I have to say that I was really impressed. The ahi tuna taco is just as good as any one I have had in the city. Might have been skimpy on the tuna, but the flavours were fresh and complementary...and the taco didn't fall into pieces while I was eating it. The salad was lovely. Great combination of textures and tastes. I will come here again, particularly for the interesting "bowls" they have (think Icelandic cod, southwest, crispy fried chicken ramen).

Our server was Sarah. She promptly came over to our table to ask us for drinks.  

When we got there it wasn't as busy as I had expected it.  But eventually it got busier.  Sarah was very attentive and kind.  She was a lovely server. 

We ordered Seared Ahi Tuna salad and it was wonderful.  I've had it before at a different location, this location had a rub on the tuna that made it so much tastier!!!! This was a hit for both of us. 

Then we had the Oreo cheesecake to go and the key lime pie to go.  The deserts here are wonderful.  

It was a really great evening.  Great staff, great food and wonderful ambiance.
The layout is horrible!! I loved the check in feature but they also seared us right next to the waiting line. Awkward and uncomfortable. Didn't even make it to dinner.
First time visiting  phenomenal atmosphere, great service and amazing food. Highly recommended and will be back!!
I have Been coming here since they opened! Staff are always friendly, food is always delicious and their $5.00 Drinks are alway refreshing!

Sitting outside patio for 30 minutes waiting for my table then told that I can't sit at a table on the freezing patio unless I plan to eat outside! Had to move to a small bench right in the draught of the open door to outside. Extremely poor service.

Found gluten free options here for spouse who is celiac ! They do take care to avoid contamination ! But price is a bit high ! The happy hour special had flavoured vodka ( which may contain gluten ) but to substitute to reg vodka price reverts to regular price ! That's ok I notice a Canadian Brewhouse opening across the road their prices are way more reasonable , with Gluten Free options !

I've been here twice in the past month or so with coworkers.

Each visit was pleasant and the food was good.  Some hits and some that were just okay but no misses - bonus!

I'd really like to come back in the evening and chill in the lounge area out front - love the décor and lots of seating options.  This place is super cute in a skull and cross bones sort of way!

LOVE love LOVE the Tuna Tataki salad - I'd order this again and again.  The tuna is pan seared on the edge and rolled in lemongrass. YES, lemongrass - sooooo freaking good!

The calamari had fried jalapenos which was a nice touch but our calamari was super greasy - felt like it had been double fried?  A tad overdone but I've had much worse.  We still gobbled it up.

The Dynamite Roll here was different and the dipping sauce was not traditional - definitely put their own twist on it with ginger and yummy goodness.  The rice was weird though that day, did NOT feel like sushi rice and fell apart when we picked it up.  It was missing the stickiness to hold it together.  I mentioned this to our server and she said depending on which sous chef is on, it's a hit or miss if the rice is sushi rice.

I haven't ordered a burger here yet but several of my companions RAVE about the house french fries.  Like they would fight over leftovers on someone's plate delicious!  

Another coworker had the deconstructed blackened chicken ceasar salad and that looked delicious as well!  The bacon was not the crumbled variety but resembled properly cooked strips that were cut thinly - really nice.

The nachos are a little different here as well with corn and crumbled cheese - queso.  Quite good.  We asked for extra salsa as there was 3 of us sharing the little bowl and there was an upcharge - not a big deal but I do think it's good practice for the server to advise when you are being upcharged and we didn't know until the bill.

The To Go or Doggy Bags here are adorable with the cross bone skull on one side and EAT in giant letters on the other.  

Two Thumbs Up for Browns!  I will most definitely be back.

Went here on a Saturday night and was quite busy.
It was a 15-20 minutes wait, but no big deal, as they will page your cell phone when a table is ready.  We just sat at the bar with a some drinks so wasn't a big deal.  It's not that big, so for weekends I would say to expect some wait during the evening.

We did order some food, my date raved about her cajun chicken salad.  I had the Dragon dish, with coconut rice, terriyaki chicken and red leaf lettuce.  I was good and filling, though just a warning that it did seem to have too much sauce on it (for those that don't like it too creamy and salty).  Drinks are priced like most places like Joey's or Earl's, they do have a house lager beer for $5.

Service was awesome, from the hostess at the front, the bartender and our waitress.  She was always attentive with checking on us and taking away plates and glasses.

Very happy to have something like this in the north and would definitely come back again.

I was excited to check out Browns but sadly all the excitement is gone. I don't get the hype. Having gone 3 times at different times of the day/week I have been overall pleased with the service, the decor is attractive but the food was disappointing every time. 

Be it a burger, a salad, or a rice bowl it was just OK. The menu on paper looks fresh and imaginative but once you order what comes out is such standard fare. For example the #28 Dragon Bowl looked awesome when others had it but when I tried it the coconut rice was undetectable, the flavours were flat and the spicy yogurt was only put on half of the dish. I started eating on the wrong side so half of the dish was flovourless. The fish tacos were overdone, the burger was plain (although the bun was amazing I fly soft). You get the idea. When you are paying in the $15-20 range for a dish you expect better.

Still my fave place to meet up with friends for eats or drinks.  Have always got great service and during Covid they have all safe precautions in place.  Once had a drink take over 10 minutes (we didn't even noticed or care since we were all busy chatting), and the manager came over and apologized and offered them on the house!  Highly recommend the crispy chicken burger.
